ns2:course.label: SW Practice with Indiv and Fam
ns2:course.description: (SOC W 400) Systematic and critical examination of procedures, and of selected practice models within four main approaches to social work: cognitive-behavioral, systemic (family and ecological systems, crisis intervention), task-centered, and radical-structural (structural, feminist). The course uses Kettner's framework for analyzing and assessing those models, examines outcome research, and identifies current practice issues. Prerequisite: SOCW 400
